name: Happiness 2
tagline: Thirty-four homes across four acres in Vijayanagar.
description: Happiness 2 is a completed villa community in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Thirty-four homes sit on four acres — thirty-two 3 BHK villas of 2,543 sq ft, plus two apartments.

items: RCC framed structure, Seismic Zone II compliant
Large windows for light and ventilation
Terrace and open space to each villa
